isolation: Use per-task stack and synthetic data only; do not send messages or contact real applicants

scenarios.title: Domain boundaries
scenarios.given: Records with every enum and Unicode boundary fixture
scenarios.when: Create with valid values, at limit and one beyond; submit client status/date; read publicly
scenarios.then: Valid records persist with server AVAILABLE/UTC; invalid fields reject with 400; code-point counts match UI; no private fields appear
scenarios.method: DTO validation, API and mapper tests

scenarios.title: Routes and return state
scenarios.given: A filtered paginated catalog is scrolled down
scenarios.when: Open a detail, use Back/Forward and Back to catalog; refresh canonical/legacy/unknown routes
scenarios.then: Session catalog state restores; direct/reload defaults apply; canonical redirects replace history; missing record and unknown route are distinct

scenarios.title: Filtering and counts
scenarios.given: A fixed catalog contains available/reserved/adopted stones across types, sizes and UTC day boundaries
scenarios.when: Apply two sizes, two types and From/To; sort all six ways; paginate; request non-AVAILABLE status
scenarios.then: OR/AND/half-open UTC rules, AVAILABLE invariant, exact total, deterministic ties and page bounds hold; no wrong-status card leaks

scenarios.title: Draft filters and chips
scenarios.given: Applied valid dates and several selected options exist
scenarios.when: Type an invalid date, filter option labels, remove hidden selections/date chip and Reset
scenarios.then: Invalid draft never replaces applied date; query does not search catalog; chips/counts share state; reset and focus behavior match requirements
scenarios.method: UI interaction tests and keyboard browser charter

scenarios.title: Responsive layout and focus
scenarios.given: Catalog/detail with chat open and filters/adoption modal available
scenarios.when: Exercise 320, 768 and 1440 px widths, 200% zoom, keyboard navigation and Escape and reduced motion
scenarios.then: No horizontal overflow or hidden focus; modal traps only when appropriate; chat respects inert background; cards and controls remain readable

scenarios.title: Loading errors and gallery
scenarios.given: Zero/one/many-photo stones and controlled response delays
scenarios.when: Load/retry failure, return successful empty result, select thumbnails, break an image and reverse request completion order
scenarios.then: States differ correctly; newest query wins; no fabricated thumbnails/retry loop; preview never changes cover; full biography remains readable
scenarios.method: Component tests and real browser checks

scenarios.title: URL expiry and contracts
scenarios.given: READY and PENDING photos with controllable signed-link expiry
scenarios.when: Read detail/draft, expire URL and refresh; inspect serialized representations
scenarios.then: Only READY has a URL; refresh bounded once; no permanent signed URL storage; response fields/enums/nullability conform to generated schema
scenarios.method: API contract tests and browser expiry case

scenarios.title: Environment loss during integration
scenarios.given: A requested batch with declared components and isolated endpoints
scenarios.when: Stop a required database, API or browser dependency between precheck and completion; change content after a passing run
scenarios.then: The batch starts only after every prerequisite passes; the watcher detects loss and marks BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT; changed content invalidates evidence; original application data is untouched

implementation: Each browser-required ticket creates its own executable quality/e2e/<TASK-ID>/*.spec.ts suite for that ticket contribution; full scenarios are aggregated at release
